author: Kai Moreno
title: Embedding dimension mismatch after a model change
content:
# Purpose
If they switched embedding models, old vectors will not match new dimensions. This is expected.

# When to use
If they switched embedding models, old vectors will not match new dimensions. This is expected.

# What Support does
P4, Support. Tell them to re-embed. Do not file as a retired model unless the call returns HTTP 410 model_retired.

# Intake
Collect the customer, the project or pool name, the region if they named one, and the outcome they want. Write those on the SUP ticket before you route.

# Priority and routing
P4, Support. Tell them to re-embed. Do not file as a retired model unless the call returns HTTP 410 model_retired. If this page and a more specific SOP both apply, the more specific SOP wins.

# Guardrails
Do not issue credits. Do not disable an org API key from this page. Do not invent a label this page does not name.

# Customer reply
Thanks, we have the request. We will follow the internal playbook for this kind of ticket and update you on the SUP thread.

# Related
Support intake checklist. Severity matrix for anything that is actually down. This page is only for the purpose above.
